title: Discrete Varying State Space
text: Discrete-time state-space model with varying matrix values, 10 inputs, 3 outputs, {Initial conditions} sets System initial conditions; {Initial condition source} sets the option to set initial condition using external signal, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Output states} sets the provide state output, {Output state derivatives} sets the provide state updates, {Enable feedthrough} adds input port for feedthrough matrix, {Enable state offsets x0} adds input port for state offsets, {Enable state derivative offsets dx0} adds input port for state derivative, {Enable input offsets u0} adds input port for input offsets and {Enable output offsets y0} adds input port for output offsets. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial condition source
params.values: Option to set initial condition using external signal internal (default) | external

params.name: Enable feedthrough
params.values: Add input port for feedthrough matrix on (default) | off

params.name: Enable state offsets x0
params.values: Add input port for state offsets off (default) | on

params.name: Enable state derivative offsets dx0
params.values: Add input port for state derivative offsets off (default) | on

params.name: Enable input offsets u0
params.values: Add input port for input offsets off (default) | on

params.name: Enable output offsets y0
params.values: Add input port for output offsets off (default) | on
